name: Changeloger – Release Notes & Changelog Manager
author: Spider Themes

sections.description:
Changeloger is the best WordPress changelog plugin for creating beautiful release notes, collecting user feedback, and sharing public product roadmaps. Replace boring text changelogs with stunning visual timelines — no coding required.

Changeloger streamlines the entire release communication workflow — from creating structured releases in the admin builder, to collecting user feedback and feature requests, to sharing your product roadmap publicly. Whether you paste plain text, upload files, or use the visual admin interface, Changeloger makes it effortless to keep your users informed and engaged.

Video Overview / How to Use Changeloger:

Key Features:

  • Seamless Integration: Changeloger effortlessly integrates into the WordPress block editor, allowing users to access its powerful features with just a few clicks.

  • Visual Design Options: Customize the appearance of your changelogs with various design options. Choose from pre-defined templates or create your own, ensuring that your changelogs match your website’s style and branding.

  • Time-Saving Automation: No more manual formatting or styling! Changeloger automates the process, converting plain text changelogs into visually appealing layouts with speed and precision.

  • Changelog Import: Users can upload their existing changelog text files, saving time and effort in the conversion process. Say goodbye to tedious copying and pasting!

  • Version Management: Easily manage multiple versions of your software or product updates with Changeloger. Users can categorize and organize changelogs by version numbers, ensuring clarity and transparency.

  • Mobile Responsiveness: Changelogs created with Changeloger are optimized for mobile devices, providing an exceptional user experience across all platforms.

  • Real-time Preview: Instantly visualize your changelog changes as you make edits, allowing you to fine-tune the design to perfection.

  • Brand Color Settings: Customize the appearance of your changelogs with various design options. Choose from pre-defined templates or create your own, ensuring that your changelogs match your website’s style and branding.

  • Customizable Badges: Add custom badges with color controls for better visual clarity.

  • Product Management: Create and manage your product (1 product in free version)

  • Change Items: Add categorized change items (Features, Fixes, Improvements, etc.) to releases

  • Draft/Publish Workflow: Save drafts and publish releases when ready

Changeloger empowers WordPress users to present their software and product updates with elegance and clarity, enhancing user engagement and comprehension. Keep your audience informed, impressed, and delighted with Changeloger – the ultimate WordPress plugin for transforming plain text changelogs into visually designed masterpieces. Download Changeloger now and elevate your changelog game to new heights!

Core Features

Free Version Includes:

Gutenberg Blocks

  • Changeloger Block – Display beautiful changelogs with plain text input or file upload
  • Tabbed Changeloger Block – Organize multiple changelogs in a tabbed interface
  • Release Hub Block – Unified display of releases, feedback, and roadmap
  • Sidebar Versions – Quick navigation with left or right sidebar version list
  • Log Tags & Color Management – Categorize entries with customizable colored badges (New, Fixed, Updated, Improved, etc.)

Admin Release Builder

  • Product Management – Create and manage your product (1 product limit in free version)
  • Release Creator – Visual interface to create releases with version numbers and dates
  • Change Items – Add categorized change items (Features, Fixes, Improvements, etc.)
  • Draft/Publish Workflow – Save drafts and publish when ready
  • Import Sample Data – Load demo releases to see how it works
  • File Import – Upload plain .txt changelog files to auto-create releases
  • Bulk Actions – Publish, draft, or delete multiple releases at once
  • Release Preview – View how your releases look on the frontend

PRO Features:

Advanced Changelog Features

  • Upload Changelog URL – Import changelog content directly from public URLs (GitHub, etc.)
  • Visual Editing – Add, edit, and delete versions and items with visual controls
  • Pagination – Break long changelogs into pages with “Load More” or numbered navigation
  • Filter Component – Let users filter by category (New, Fixed, Updated, Improved)
  • Search Option – Enable keyword search within changelog content
  • Layout Switch – Multiple layout styles for organized display
  • Unlimited Products – Create and manage unlimited products (vs 1 in free)

Email Subscription System

  • Subscription Form – Display email subscription form on changelog
  • Email Notifications – Automatically notify subscribers of new releases
  • Auto Version Tracking – Monitors changelog for new versions and sends emails
  • Custom Email Templates – Customize from name, from email, and subject with placeholders
  • Double Opt-in – Confirmation email for new subscribers

Feedback Manager

  • Feedback Collection – Frontend form for users to submit feature requests and bug reports
  • Feedback Dashboard – Dedicated admin page to view and manage all feedback
  • Voting System – Let users upvote/downvote feedback items
  • Comment Threads – Allow discussions on feedback items
  • Status Management – Track feedback through workflow (Open, Under Review, Planned, In Progress, Completed, Closed)
  • Category Organization – Organize feedback with categories (Feature Request, Bug Report, Improvement, Question)
  • User Authentication – Require login or allow guest submissions
  • Google Login – Enable Google OAuth for easy sign-in

Roadmap Builder

  • Public Roadmap – Share your product roadmap as a beautiful Kanban board
  • Kanban Board – Visual columns for different statuses (Under Review, Planned, In Progress, Done)
  • Roadmap Items – Create and manage roadmap items with titles, descriptions, and priorities
  • Feedback Integration – Link roadmap items to user feedback
  • Vote Display – Show vote counts on roadmap items (optional)
  • Drag & Drop – Move items between columns to update status
  • Priority Levels – Set Low, Medium, or High priority on items

Release Subscription

  • Subscribe for Updates – Display a subscription widget on your changelog for users to opt in to release notifications
  • Double Opt-in – Logged-out users enter name and email, then confirm via a verification email before being subscribed
  • Instant Subscribe – Logged-in users subscribe with a single click — no confirmation email required
  • One-Click Unsubscribe – Subscribed users can unsubscribe instantly by clicking the “Subscribed” button
  • Email Notifications – Automatically send notification emails to subscribers when a new release is published
  • Custom Email Templates – Customize sender name, sender email, and subject line with {product} and {version} placeholders
  • AI Enhanced Email – Generate personalized notification emails with AI-powered subject lines, intros, and summaries (requires Antimanual)

Additional Pro Features

  • Version Tracking – Auto-detect new versions and notify subscribers
  • Google Authentication – Set up Google OAuth for user login
  • Advanced Statistics – View detailed stats for releases, feedback, and roadmap

View All Features

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/changeloger directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the block editor and search for “Changeloger” to add a changelog block, or navigate to Changeloger → Dashboard to use the Release Builder.
sections.faq:
1. What is Changeloger?

Changeloger is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows users to convert plain text changelogs into visually designed and engaging representations. It streamlines the process of presenting software or product updates in a user-friendly format within the WordPress block editor.

2. How do I install Changeloger?

Installing Changeloger is easy. Simply go to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to “Plugins,” click on “Add New,” search for “Changeloger,” and click “Install Now.” Once installed, activate the plugin, and you’re ready to use it.

3. Can I use my existing changelog files with Changeloger?

Absolutely! Changeloger provides a convenient “Changelog Import” feature, allowing you to upload your plain text changelog files. This saves time and effort, eliminating the need for manual entry.

4. Can I customize the appearance of my changelogs?

Certainly! Changeloger offers several customization options, including font styles, colors, layout formats, and more. You can personalize your changelogs to ensure they align with your website’s design and aesthetic.

5. Is Changeloger compatible with the WordPress block editor?

Yes, Changeloger is fully integrated with the WordPress block editor, making it seamless to create and manage visually designed changelogs directly within your content.

6. How does Changeloger help with version management?

Changeloger simplifies version management by allowing you to categorize and organize changelogs based on version numbers. This ensures clarity and makes it easier for users to understand the progression of updates.

7. Is Changeloger mobile responsive?

Absolutely! The changelogs created with Changeloger are optimized for mobile devices, providing a seamless user experience across all platforms.

8. Can I preview changelog changes in real-time?

Yes, Changeloger offers a real-time preview feature, enabling you to see how your changelog looks as you make edits. This allows you to fine-tune the design to perfection before publishing.

9. Is there any support available for Changeloger users?

Of course! Changeloger provides comprehensive customer support to assist users with any queries, technical issues, or customization needs. Reach out to our support team, and we’ll be happy to help you.

10. Does Changeloger work with all WordPress themes?

Yes, Changeloger is designed to work seamlessly with most WordPress themes. It ensures compatibility with the block editor and offers a consistent experience across different themes.

11. Can I use Changeloger for non-software related changelogs?

Absolutely! While Changeloger is ideal for software updates, it can be used for any changelog scenario where you want to visually present changes or updates to your audience.

12. Does Changeloger include a roadmap and feedback system?

Yes! Changeloger Pro includes a full public roadmap builder (Kanban-style) and a user feedback board with voting, comments, and status tracking — so you can manage your entire product loop from one plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.6.0 (26 February 2026)

  • New: Brand Color settings for consistent product styling.
  • Improved: Overall changelog quality validation logic and messaging refined.
  • Improved: Minor UI and styling enhancements across all features.

1.5.0 (14 February 2026)

  • Improved: Optimized asset localization and fixed script path issues for better reliability
  • Improved: admin dashboard performance with optimized stats queries
  • Improved: Replaced inefficient loop-based queries with a single optimized GROUP BY query for feedback statistics
  • Improved: badge system with advanced customization options
  • Optimized: product count handling using wp_count_terms instead of fetching all terms
  • Optimized: Release Hub page lookup with improved caching and proper cache invalidation
  • Added: Badge customization settings in Changeloger → Settings → Releases → Badge
  • Added: Ability to add custom badges with color controls for better visual clarity
  • Fixed: Minor performance bottlenecks affecting admin dashboard load time
  • Fixed: Various internal optimizations and stability improvements

1.4.0 (21 January 2026)

  • New: Admin Release Builder – Visual interface to create and manage releases with version numbers, dates, and change items
  • New: Product Management – Create and manage your product (1 product in free version)
  • New: Change Items – Add categorized change items (Features, Fixes, Improvements, etc.) to releases
  • New: Draft/Publish Workflow – Save drafts and publish releases when ready
  • New: Import Sample Data – Load demo releases to see how the Release Builder works
  • New: File Import – Upload plain .txt changelog files to auto-create releases
  • New: Bulk Actions – Publish, draft, or delete multiple releases at once
  • New: Release Preview – View how your releases look on the frontend
  • New: Release Hub Block – Unified display of releases (Feedback and Roadmap available in Pro)
  • Improved: Overall UI/UX with modern, clean design
  • Improved: Performance optimizations for better loading times
  • Fixed: Various minor bugs and stability improvements

1.3.0 (24 November 2025)

  • Improved: Minor UI, performance, and stability improvements across the Changeloger plugin

1.2.0 (24 November 2025)

  • New: Added Changeloger input field for uploading Changelog URL
  • Fixed: Minor bugs and improved overall stability

1.1.0 (18 November 2025)

  • Enhanced: Tabbed Changeloger interface development in progress for a more organized viewing experience
  • Updated: Freemius SDK updated to 2.13.0

1.0.1 (18 March 2025)

  • New: Added color control for pagination button on hover
  • New: Added an option for Loading sample data (you can see the changeloer frontend view with sample data if you want)
  • New: Integrate with EazyDocs
  • Tweaked: Improved Color control

1.0.0 (Oct 11 2024)

  • Tweaked: Now the Date and Version format will detect more intelligently.
  • Tweaked: Anchor tag support in the changelog item content.
  • Tweaked: Ignore empty line in the changelog content. Unwanted empty line will be removed/skipped automatically.
  • Tweaked: Design was breaking in the block editor, now fixed.
  • New: Regex condition added to find Markdown-style links and convert them to HTML anchor tags in the changelog content.

0.1.0 (Dec 9 2023)

  • Initial release of Changeloger plugin.
